home.prompt: What do you want to do?

howItWorksSteps.title: Need to send?
howItWorksSteps.body: Post what you want to send, where it needs to go, and when.

howItWorksSteps.title: Have extra luggage space?
howItWorksSteps.body: Post your trip and available capacity.

howItWorksSteps.title: Find a match
howItWorksSteps.body: Browse compatible send and carry requests.

howItWorksSteps.title: Connect
howItWorksSteps.body: Both sides accept → connect privately on Telegram.

howItWorksSteps.title: 100% Free
howItWorksSteps.body: No fees • No commission • No hidden charges.

landing.browseHint: You can read listings here. To connect with a sender or traveler, open the request in Telegram.
landing.matchHint: Matching and messaging happen in the Mini App. This page is only for discovery.

auth.failed: Could not sign in with Telegram.
auth.openHint: We'll open the Mini App inside Telegram. If that fails, you'll land in the bot chat — not a browser.
auth.devHint: Open this Mini App from Telegram for real login. In the browser, continue as a local user (DEBUG only).

form.kgFromCategories: Suggested from categories: {kg} kg. You can change it.
form.kgPickCategories: Pick categories to suggest a weight.
form.categoryChoiceHint: Everything starts as can-carry. Tap an item to move it to will not carry.
form.canCarryHint: Tap an item to say you will not take it.
form.willNotCarryHint: Tap an item to move it back to can-carry.
form.canCarryEmpty: Keep at least one item you can carry.
form.needCarry: Keep at least one item you can carry.
form.categoryConflict: A category cannot be both carried and excluded.
form.pickDestCity: Choose one or more destination cities, then tap continue.
form.needDestCity: Select at least one destination city.
form.pickDestCities: Select one or more destination cities.
form.stepTripHintDemand: When do you want it sent, and how heavy is it?
form.stepTripHintSupply: When do you fly, and which dates can you carry something?
form.stepCargoHintSupply: Everything starts as can-carry. Tap an item you will not take.
form.sameCity: Destination must be different from origin.
form.dateOrder: End date must be on or after the start date.
form.stepReviewHint: Check this summary, then confirm. We publish it on the channel after you approve.

requests.title: My requests
requests.cancelConfirm: Cancel this request? Matches will expire and contact details will be hidden.
requests.closeHint: Closing stops new matches and messages for this request.
requests.suggestedLead: These are the best matches for this request. Request the ones you want.
requests.pickLead: Review the top matches and request the ones you want.
requests.createdLead: We posted your request. Pick a suitable match below.
requests.createdPickLead: Request a Koolbar user, or open a channel listing on Telegram.
requests.createdEmpty: No matches yet. Compatible senders or travelers will show up here.
requests.noMatches: No matches yet. Compatible senders or travelers will show up here so you can request them.

matches.title: My matches
matches.requestHint: Send a request. The other person will accept to connect.
matches.acceptHint: They requested this match. Accept to connect.
matches.connectedBody: You can now message each other on Telegram to arrange the handover.
matches.waitingOther: Request sent. Waiting for them to accept.
matches.waitingYou: They requested this match. Accept to connect.
matches.noUsername: They have no public @username. Copy the message below, then paste it in Telegram.
matches.finishConfirm: Mark this order as finished? Both of you can then rate.
matches.rateHint: Both sides can rate after the order is finished.
matches.waitingRate: Waiting for the other person to rate.

explore.title: Open requests
explore.hint: Browse open send & carry requests and propose a match. The engine also suggests compatible pairs automatically.
explore.empty: No open requests match these filters.
explore.chooseYours: Which of your requests should we pair?
explore.needDemand: Create a send request first to match this traveler.
explore.needSupply: Create a traveler request first to match this sender.
